:::{#def-integrable}
#### Riemann integrable

A bounded function $f$ is **Riemann integrable on** $[a, b]$
if the Riemann sums (@def-riemann-sum) $\sumin f(x_i^*)\,\change x_i$,
over partitions $\mathcal{P}$ of $[a, b]$ (@def-partition)
with a sample point $x_i^*$ in each subinterval $[x_{i-1}, x_i]$,
approach a real-number limit as the mesh $\norm{\mathcal{P}}$ (@def-mesh) shrinks to zero,
and that limit is the same
for every choice of the partitions and of the sample points.

[@larsonCalc11e, Section 4.3, p. 272]

:::
